name: BodyTalk_16
short_caption: The robot subtly pulls its hands inward toward its stomach and then releases them back to its sides.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot brings both hands slightly inward and upward toward the lower torso, bending its elbows. The hands trace a small inward circle before smoothly returning to the default hanging position at the sides. The head and torso remain stable and forward-facing throughout the brief movement.
safety_notes: None, the arms stay within the body's main profile footprint.
